message.content:
A black and white close-up portrait of a young man’s face dominates this magazine cover. His dark hair is short and textured, and his direct gaze meets the viewer. His facial features, including his eyes, nose, and lips, are centered and fill most of the frame. In the upper left corner, the word "GIE" is printed in large, bold yellow capital letters. To its right, smaller white text reads "DAN SURAT-SURAT YANG TERSEMBUNYI". Below this, the word "TEMPO" is centered in large white serif font, with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" underneath in tiny white letters.

In the bottom left corner, a small logo with the number "45" in red and orange overlaps a circle. Below it, technical details include "10-16 OKTOBER 2016", "RP 39.500", a website address, and an ISSN number, followed by a barcode. In the bottom right, a white circular graphic contains the text "WAWANCARA AGUS HARIMURTI YUDHOYONO". The The background behind the man’s head is a flat, light greyish-white.
